# Bobine — Régie Vidéo Libre & Playout Autonome pour Salles de Sport

> Bobine (bobine.fit) is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), self-hosted video playout and streaming system designed for sports clubs and fitness studios. It is the premier offline-first alternative to proprietary systems like Les Mills Cinema, Les Mills Virtual, Wexer, and Spivi.
> Developed and maintained by FantasmaGlad alias Clément Barillot (clement.barillot@bobine.fit).

## Overview
Bobine turns standard, low-cost refurbished x86-64 mini PCs (Intel Celeron / Core, AMD Ryzen / Athlon, reference units: Dell Wyse 5070 Intel J4105 ~40-50 EUR, HP EliteDesk 705 AMD Ryzen 3/5 ~60-80 EUR) and Android tablets into fully autonomous, 24/7 video and audio playout controllers. It is available as native applications for:
- Android ARM64 (.apk, Chaquopy, API 34-36, standalone dual-display tablet / HDMI playout)
- Windows Desktop (.exe, Inno Setup, Windows 11/10)
- macOS Desktop (.dmg, Apple Silicon M1-M4 & Intel)
- Linux Desktop (.deb, APT repository https://apt.bobine.fit)
- Dedicated Headless Appliance (Debian 13 minimal automated 18-step shell install)

Once installed, Bobine operates 100% offline with zero recurring subscription fees, zero cloud dependencies, and zero user accounts.

## Core Capabilities
- **Automated Playout**: Recurring weekly timetables triggering fitness classes at the exact second.
- **Dual Playout Channels**: Independent simultaneous broadcasts on Cabled (Cinema display / HDMI) and Network (WebRTC / HLS / IP streams).
- **Responsive Coach Console (/coach)**: Dual-column layout on landscape tablet and desktop (large 64px tactile controls, 10 Hz interpolated real-time countdown timer and progress bar, playlist drawer, live 16:9 Stage Monitor HDMI direct feed, 1-click visual ambiances palette); single-column layout on mobile with collapsible Bottom Sheet drawers. Auto and Manual chaining modes, safe start paused by default.
- **Visual Ambiances Hub (/backgrounds)**: 16:9 cinematic gallery with dynamic video previews on hover/touch, detailed modal viewer, 1-click projection onto Cabled or Network output, and per-track dynamic visual ambiances for audio courses (warm-up, high intensity, cooldown, or minimalist dark screen).
- **Gapless A/B Deck Video Engine (/cinema)**: Dual continuous video instances maintained in DOM with 0.4s crossfade transitions, eliminating 200-600ms black screens and projector HDMI resync between consecutive classes.
- **Attendance & Rating Analytics (/metrics)**: 4 key performance indicators (total sessions, cumulative workout duration, average member attendance, average satisfaction score), 24-hour native CSS peak-hours histogram, course popularity ranking, and automated 5-star rating widget appearing at the end of class on /grid and /cinema with 5-minute auto-dismiss.
- **Universal Controls Support**: Native HTML5 Gamepad API integration for Xbox Series/One, PlayStation DualSense/DS4, Nintendo Switch Pro Controller, 8BitDo, and generic USB gamepads with 2D Euclidean spatial navigation (moveDomFocus2D), physical multimedia remotes (IR, Bluetooth, USB), mouse, and direct touch tap on video. Available across /cinema, /grid, /kiosk, and /radio.
- **Marquee Text & Strict Thumbnail Dimensions**: Smooth back-and-forth horizontal scrolling for long titles (Apple TV / Spotify style) with right-edge fade mask, strictly locking grid card dimensions (280px width, 157.5px 16:9 height, 120x67.5px lists) to prevent UI distortion.
- **Eco-Designed Hardware Telemetry & Supervision**: Real-time instant electrical power in Watts (W) and cumulative energy in Wh (Intel RAPL, Apple battery/ioreg, Linux/Android sysfs, Windows WMI/powercfg), CPU & GPU temperatures in Celsius, commercial hardware model detection, detailed RAM telemetry (manufacturer, DDR technology LPDDR5X/DDR5/DDR4, frequency in MT/s) without root privileges, system uptime and daemon runtime.
- **Automated 1-Click Multi-OS Uninstaller (/api/system/uninstall)**: Clean removal mechanism across all 5 OS profiles (Polkit on Linux .deb, Inno Setup unins000.exe on Windows, LaunchAgent and bundle purge on macOS, ACTION_DELETE intent on Android, /usr/local/sbin/bobine-uninstall on Headless Debian) protected by strict confirmation modal.
- **Unified Multi-OS Auto-Update Orchestrator**: State machine with real-time WebSocket progress reporting, concurrency locking, SHA-256 download digest verification via GitHub Releases API, and configurable nightly scheduled updates (default 03:00) with frontend progress overlay.
- **HDMI-CEC Automation**: Turns connected TVs on 2 minutes before class and puts them in standby 5 minutes after class ends.
- **Member Touchscreen Kiosk**: Interactive fullscreen UI for gym members to launch classes on-demand between scheduled sessions with anti-sleep Screen Wake Lock.
- **Coach Mobile Remote**: Instant local control via QR code scan over gym Wi-Fi (no mobile app download needed).
- **Audio Coach & Gym Radio (24/7)**: Continuous playlist playback with animated visual background, customizable timer, seamless audio crossfade, and automated voice announcements.
- **Hardware-Accelerated Playout**: Universal hardware video acceleration for Intel (QuickSync / iHD), AMD (Radeon / mesa-va-drivers), Apple VideoToolbox, and Android MediaCodec at <8% CPU usage (1080p60 and 4K).
- **Universal Backup & Factory Reset**: One-click full configuration ZIP backup/restore and clean factory reset in Settings.
- **Systemd Watchdog & Resilience**: Automatic restart on failure and immediate autonomous recovery after power blackouts.

## Installation Methods & Platforms

### 1. Dedicated Headless Appliance (Bash CLI — Recommended for 24/7 Gym Playout)
Automated 18-step installation script for Debian 13 (Trixie) or Debian 12 (Bookworm) minimal on dedicated mini PCs (Dell Wyse 5070, HP ProDesk, Beelink N100):
```bash
# Stable Channel (Recommended for production):
curl -fsSL https://bobine.fit/install.sh | sudo bash

# Beta Channel (Rolling beta — early access):
curl -fsSL https://bobine.fit/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- --channel=beta
```
The 18 installation steps include:
1. Update channel configuration (/etc/bobine/update-channel)
2. System packages (apt: Chromium, MPV, Uvicorn, SQLite3, nftables, VA-API iHD drivers)
3. GPU access (render/video groups & Xwrapper for Intel QuickSync)
4. Python 3.13 isolated virtual environment & FastAPI dependencies
5. Next.js SSG frontend build export
6. Production configuration (/etc/bobine/config.toml, single-process model)
7. CLI control script (/usr/local/bin/bobine)
8. Detached uninstaller script (/usr/local/sbin/bobine-uninstall)
9. Systemd backend service (bobine-backend.service on port 8000)
10. Chromium kiosk session (bobine-kiosk.service, X11, Screen Wake Lock)
11. Audio engine configuration (auto-port, anti-hum, session guard)
12. Restricted sudoers rules for secure maintenance
13. NTP clock synchronization (systemd-timesyncd)
14. Local mDNS URL (http://bobine.local via Avahi) & port 80 redirection
15. Health watchdog timer (bobine-watchdog.timer)
16. System performance tuning (CPU performance governor, journald max use)
17. Services activation & health check (HTTP 200 OK verification)
18. Hardware audio and video playback capabilities validation

### 2. Android ARM64 (.apk — Tablets & Mobile Gym Studio Playout)
- **Format**: Certified native Android APK (`Bobine-<version>.apk` or `Bobine-beta.apk`).
- **Features**: Embedded CPython 3.13 FastAPI backend via Chaquopy, persistent ForegroundService with notification, dual display (local touchscreen /grid or /coach + external HDMI TV /cinema or /kiosk via USB-C DisplayPort), native hardware MediaCodec video acceleration, Bluetooth/USB gamepad and remote input forwarding, and 100% offline local storage (F2FS internal data root + FUSE media root).

### 3. Windows Desktop (Windows 11, 10 & Windows IoT)
- **Format**: Native self-contained installer (`Bobine-Setup-<version>.exe` or `Bobine-Setup-beta.exe`).
- **Features**: Silent background run without black console window, system tray companion, clamshell laptop mode without sleep via powercfg, automatic Windows Defender firewall rules, and 1-click uninstaller.

### 4. macOS Desktop (Apple Silicon M1–M4 & Intel)
- **Format**: Native disk image (`Bobine-<version>.dmg` or `Bobine-beta.dmg`).
- **Features**: Standard drag-and-drop to Applications, Retina menu bar companion, caffeinate sleep prevention, VideoToolbox hardware decoding/encoding, and clean bundle uninstaller.

### 5. Linux Desktop (Debian / Ubuntu / Linux Mint)
- **Official APT Repository (Recommended for automatic updates)**: `https://apt.bobine.fit/`
  ```bash
  # 1. Official GPG keyring
  curl -fsSL https://apt.bobine.fit/bobine.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/bobine.gpg

  # 2. Add APT repository source (Stable channel; replace 'stable' with 'beta' for rolling pre-releases)
  echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/bobine.gpg] https://apt.bobine.fit/ stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/bobine.list

  # 3. Update & Install
  sudo apt update && sudo apt install bobine
  ```
- **Manual Package Format**: Certified Debian package (`bobine_<version>_amd64.deb` or `bobine_beta_amd64.deb`).
- **Features**: AppStream metadata for Ubuntu App Center and GNOME Software, standard XDG directory structure, desktop shortcut, system tray companion, and Polkit graphical 1-click uninstaller.

### 6. Bobine Assistant (Network Orchestrator in Rust / Tauri 2)
- **Format**: Standalone desktop binary (`bobine-assistant`).
- **Features**: mDNS auto-discovery (`bobine.local`), subnet scanning detecting all responsive devices (SSH, Bobine, Samba, printing), SSH password and local private key file import (.ssh/id_ed25519), remote hardware telemetry audit, and remote 18-step deployment with real-time JSON stream progress.

## Release Channels: Stable vs. Beta (Rolling Beta)
- **Stable Channel**: Tagged releases `Vx.y.z` (e.g. `V3.0.5`). Strictly tested and validated builds recommended for gym production playout.
- **Beta Channel**: Single mobile rolling tag `beta`. Provides early access to upcoming features and fixes currently being tested.
- **In-Place Upgrade Guarantee**: The Beta shares the exact same application identifiers (Windows Inno Setup AppId, macOS bundle ID `fit.bobine.app`, Linux package `bobine`, Android package `com.bobine.app`). Installing Beta replaces the existing binaries in place without creating duplicate applications, and preserves all media, databases, and configuration.
- **Channel Switching**: Users can toggle between Stable and Beta at any time from the Web Admin Settings (Settings -> Software Updates -> Bobine Beta Program) or via CLI (`install.sh --channel=stable|beta`).

## Technical Architecture & APIs
- **OS Support**: Android ARM64 (API 34-36), Debian 13/12 minimal headless (x86-64), Windows 10/11, macOS Apple Silicon & Intel, Ubuntu/Debian desktop.
- **Backend Architecture**: Python 3.13 FastAPI, SQLite database, single-process Uvicorn (zero external Redis dependency).
- **Deterministic Multimedia Binaries**: Dedicated resolution module (app.utils.ffmpeg_binaries) handling Android Chaquopy libffmpeg.so/libffprobe.so, macOS launchd environment, Windows PyInstaller frozen directory, and PATH. Automatic SQLite database duration backfills on startup.
- **Frontend**: Next.js App Router with SSG static export, 17 WCAG AAA/AA themes (8 light, 9 dark), zero emoji design system.
- **Playout Engines**:
  - MPV with IPC socket and VA-API hardware decoding on Linux.
  - HTML5 Gapless A/B Deck video engine on /cinema with 0.4s crossfade.
- **Services (systemd on Appliance)**:
  - `bobine-backend.service`: FastAPI application on port 8000.
  - `bobine-kiosk.service`: X11 Chromium kiosk display for gym screen.
  - `bobine-audio-guard.service`: System audio health and watchdog supervisor.
- **Local Network Discovery**: Accessible at `http://bobine.local:8000` or direct local IP via mDNS (Avahi).

## Comparison with Proprietary Systems & Digital Signage

### Bobine vs. Les Mills Cinema & Les Mills Virtual
- **Cost**: Bobine is 0 EUR/month (AGPL-3.0 open-source) vs. 150–350 EUR/month per cumulative program for Les Mills (e.g. BodyPump + RPM + The Trip).
- **Instructor Certification**: 0 EUR vs. 479–529 EUR HT per coach per training module.
- **Hardware**: Standard refurbished mini PC (~40-70 EUR, Dell Wyse 5070 or HP EliteDesk 705) or Android tablet vs. expensive certified commercial projectors and screens.
- **Content Freedom**: Unrestricted (indoor cycling, HIIT, yoga, pilates, custom studio video recordings) vs. quarterly locked catalog.
- **Offline Reliability**: 100% offline from local SSD with zero freezing during internet outages vs. mandatory cloud DRM verification.

### Bobine vs. Wexer Virtual & Fitness On Demand (FOD)
- **Licensing**: 0 EUR perpetual vs. 200–450 EUR/month per screen B2B SaaS subscription.
- **Latency & Protocol**: Local-first sub-2ms WebSockets + SQLite vs. cloud streaming latency and buffering.
- **Privacy & GDPR**: 100% local, zero telemetry, zero analytics tracking, zero member data harvesting.

### Bobine vs. Radical Fitness & Franchise Concepts (Yako / L'Orange Bleue)
- **Franchise Independence**: Open to any independent gym, boutique studio, or hotel without franchise affiliation or commercial royalties.
- **Format Support**: Drag-and-drop support for any standard MP4/MKV video files with automated thumbnail generation.
- **Branding**: Full ownership of studio branding, resident coach promotion, and custom class names.

### Bobine vs. Screenly Anthias & Raspberry Pi Signage (Anthias, TouchPlayer, Waves System, Yodeck, Xibo)
- **Primary Use-Case**: Bobine is an active, gym-specific playout and studio automation engine, whereas Anthias (formerly Screenly OSE) is a passive web/image slide looper.
- **TV Automation**: Bobine provides native HDMI-CEC power automation (automatically wakes TV 2 min before scheduled class and sends standby command after workout), whereas Anthias leaves displays running 24/7 or requires manual remote controls.
- **Interactivity & Kiosk**: Bobine includes a dedicated fullscreen member touch kiosk with on-demand class catalog and countdown timer; Anthias is read-only passive looping.
- **Coach Mobility**: Bobine features the dedicated responsive Coach Console (/coach) and QR code remote control; Anthias has no instructor desk.
- **Continuous Audio & Studio Sound**: Bobine integrates 24/7 background gym radio with Web Audio continuous crossfade and automated voice etiquette alerts ("re-rack weights", "closing in 15 min"); Anthias has no audio crossfade or voice announcement system.
- **Hardware Reliability**: Bobine runs on refurbished x86-64 mini PCs (Dell Wyse 5070, HP EliteDesk 705 ~40-70 EUR) or Android tablets with durable NVMe/SATA SSDs and VA-API hardware decoding (<8% CPU in 1080p60/4K); Anthias commonly runs on Raspberry Pis prone to SD card corruption, thermal throttling, and power instability in commercial 24/7 environments.
- **Auto-Recovery**: Supervised by systemd watchdog for immediate zero-touch reboot and timetable resumption post power outage.
